description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_inflow_weno5.esm (model AdvectionWENO5Inflow, test mms_steady_inflow_weno5) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the open-boundary WENO5 inflow/outflow first-derivative rule weno5_D_inflow_bc (fifth-order interior WENO5-Z conservative flux difference, reduced-order WENO3 one-sided reconstruction near the walls, prescribed inflow ghost gL at the left wall and non-reflecting zeroth-order extrapolation at the right wall). Pins the WENO5 lowering (ic wiring at t=0) and bounds the steady-drift transport error at t=0.1. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust TERMINATES on this case as of EarthSciAST dc76c5bf and passes its own inline MMS assertions (Erk, reltol 1e-10 / abstol 1e-12, ~3 s): the whole-array overlay retired the per-cell-interpreter hang the previous note described, so the 'drives dt->0 without terminating' half of that note is obsolete. What remains, and is NOT stale, is its second half -- the Rust actual misses the 1e-9 cross-binding-actuals floor against the Julia (Tsit5) reference: mms_steady_inflow_weno5[2] L2_error 1.5728295233743465e-4 (rust) vs 1.5728295600758084e-4 (julia), 2.3e-8 relative. Reproduced bit-identically across two independent runs, so this is a deterministic Erk-vs-Tsit5 method-disagreement floor, not flakiness and not a discretization error. MEASURED 2026-07-28 against EarthSciAST dc76c5bf via scripts/runners/run-rust.sh. Re-arm when both bindings run the same integrator, or when SIM_CROSS_RTOL in scripts/compare-outputs.py admits solver-method disagreement -- the sibling cases advection_2d_x_zero_grad_central and advection_2d_y_zero_grad_central are excluded for exactly this reason and nothing else.
